about: [O1] The feel measure (GAME_TWO §1 A1, brief O1 §7): the latency of W on foot (trusted key down to the first frame the eye moves), of W in the car (to the first frame the car moves) and of A (to the first frame the wheel turns), each under 50 ms. tools/lib/o1_city.mjs 'latency'. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_latency.json

steps.check: D.foot && D.foot.ms != null && D.foot.ms < 50 && D.car && D.car.ms != null && D.car.ms < 50 && D.steer && D.steer.ms != null && D.steer.ms < 50
steps.label: W on foot, W in the car, A in the car: the first frame of the act within 50 ms
